name: Bloodhound (4 Winds Fantasy Gaming)
body:
School transmutation; Level ranger 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 10 min./level

DESCRIPTION

Your senses sharpen, making tracking easier. The DC of Survival checks made to follow tracks is decreased by 5 for the duration of the spell.
